description: 게임: 플레이어가 보는 것이 바뀌었는지, 실제로 띄워 확인했는지 판정

player_facing.instructions: Does this change alter what the player sees, hears, or controls, or the game's balance numbers (as opposed to internal refactoring, tooling, tests, or documentation only)?

run_verified.instructions: Does the evidence show that the game was actually launched after the change and the changed part was observed (a run command with its result, a screenshot path, or a described observation), rather than only automated tests passing?

human_played.instructions: Does the evidence show that a human (not an AI agent or a script) played the changed part of the game?
